rfPlan.notes: RF check on the day, coordinated with production.

jsa.airspaceHazards: No NOTAMs affecting ops area at time of flight
jsa.groundHazards:
Members of public present — 30 m separation maintained
Trees/structures limiting emergency landing options — alternate LZ identified
Spectators / crowd — VO briefed and boundaries marked

risks.hazard: RPA collision with person — OONP Pathway 2 energy limits
risks.riskDescription: Risk of injury from contact with drone operating over or near consenting/non-consenting persons at night, compounded by reduced visual detection.
risks.existingControls: Hardware-limited max speed to maintain ≤15 J over non-consenting persons and ≤34 J over consenting persons. Height limited accordingly. Prop guards installed. Informed consent obtained within OONP zone. 5 m buffer from non-consenting persons. Energy calculations documented and reviewed pre-flight.
risks.additionalControls: Brief participants not to approach drone if it descends. Reinforce buffer distances. Enhance VO callouts at night. Add illumination to TOLZ boundaries.

risks.hazard: Loss of control — GNSS drift, compass error or failsafe (OONP/EVLOS)
risks.riskDescription: Abnormal descent or lateral movement into crowd during EVLOS gap, with reduced visual recovery options at night.
risks.existingControls: Failsafe programmed per EVLOS/OONP procedures. Hardware-limited speed and altitude to maintain ≤15 J / ≤34 J worst-case energy. Pre- and post-flight inspections. GNSS/IMU health verified. Prop guards installed. VO positioned for EVLOS and proximity monitoring.
risks.additionalControls: Abort on GNSS drift warning, compass deviation, or RF interference. Restrict manoeuvres to stable envelope. Enhance VO communications at night.

risks.hazard: Unauthorised / non-consenting persons entering OONP zone at night
risks.riskDescription: Collision risk — persons harder to detect at boundaries in low light.
risks.existingControls: Designated OONP operating zone with illuminated signage and visual boundary markers. VO monitors ingress points with torchlight or lighting. TOLZ isolated. Drone trajectory restricted to ≤15 J envelope if consent not confirmed.
risks.additionalControls: Increase illuminated signage density. Add soft lit barriers. VO continuous monitoring of boundaries with lighting.

risks.hazard: Sudden weather change — wind/gusts during night OONP operations
risks.riskDescription: Loss of aircraft stability or drift into crowd with reduced visual detection of drift at night.
risks.existingControls: Weather assessed pre-flight. No OONP operations during rain, storms, or winds exceeding aircraft limits. Pilot and VO monitor drift via aircraft lighting orientation.
risks.additionalControls: Lower max altitude in marginal conditions. Abort immediately if turbulence observed near structures or crowd.

risks.hazard: Battery failure / voltage drop during overhead OONP pass at night
risks.riskDescription: Unexpected descent over crowd — harder to manage in darkness.
risks.existingControls: Batteries cycle-tested and inspected. Land at 20–25% reserve. Height restricted to maintain ≤15 J over non-consenting persons and ≤34 J over consenting persons. Controlled TOLZ with illumination.
risks.additionalControls: Use only validated packs. Battery temperature monitored. Limit throttle envelope during overhead passes.

risks.hazard: Night operations — reduced visibility / pilot and VO misjudgement (CASA 01/17)
risks.riskDescription: Pilot or VO misjudgement of position, altitude or attitude in low light, compounded by OONP proximity to persons.
risks.existingControls: Aircraft anti-collision and orientation lighting active. TOLZ adequately illuminated. VO positioned to ensure visibility of aircraft against background. Speed and altitude reduced at night to maintain ≤15 J / ≤34 J energy envelope.
risks.additionalControls: Add ground lighting along TOLZ boundary lines. Reduce manoeuvre envelope at night. VO maintains continuous verbal attitude and position callouts.

risks.riskDescription: Pilot confusion leading to unstable flight behaviour near crowd during night EVLOS segment.
risks.existingControls: Defined EVLOS communication protocol established and rehearsed. VO maintains LOS and provides direction cues. Energy limits (≤15 J / ≤34 J) maintained at all times.
risks.additionalControls: Practice handover procedure before flight. Shorten EVLOS segments in darkness. Use radio headsets for clear communications.

risks.hazard: Video transmission loss / FPV feed drop at night
risks.riskDescription: Pilot disorientation in darkness leading to abnormal flight behaviour during OONP operation.
risks.existingControls: VO maintains LOS at all times. Flight envelope restricted to predictable headings. Failsafe configured for controlled descent or RTH maintaining ≤15 J / ≤34 J energy limits.
risks.additionalControls: Reduce distance from pilot. Avoid occlusions. Use isolated VTX channel. Backup feed tested pre-flight.

risks.hazard: RF interference — broadcast rigs, LED walls, WiFi at venue
risks.riskDescription: Drop in control link or video feed in OONP area with reduced visual recovery options at night.
risks.existingControls: Control link checked pre-flight. Known interference sources avoided. VO prepared for LOS override. Energy-limited envelope maintained.
risks.additionalControls: Increase separation from RF emitters. Conduct spectrum scan if available prior to night ops.

risks.hazard: Intoxicated or unpredictable crowd behaviour at night event
risks.riskDescription: Persons entering TOLZ or approaching drone under influence, creating collision risk in darkness.
risks.existingControls: Public signage. Security and event staff briefed and positioned. VO stationed at high-risk ingress. Energy kept ≤15 J over non-consenting individuals.
risks.additionalControls: Add roped and illuminated barrier around TOLZ at night events. Increase security presence if crowd management risk elevated.

risks.riskDescription: Mid-air collision with serious consequences — reduced mutual detection at night.
risks.existingControls: OONP altitude limited. Max AGL ≤400 ft in Class G. VO continuously monitors for manned aircraft. RPA lighting active. Immediate land-now procedure.
risks.additionalControls: Reconfirm airspace activity pre-flight. VO positioned facing likely approach corridor.

risks.hazard: Collision with overhead cables, staging or lighting rigs at night
risks.riskDescription: Debris falling on persons below, or RPA disabled with uncontrolled descent into crowd.
risks.existingControls: Site walk completed in daylight. All identified obstacles marked with illuminated tape or lights for night ops. VO assigned to obstacle monitoring.
risks.additionalControls: Illuminate or flag all rigging in operational area prior to night ops.

risks.riskDescription: Burn injury or ignition hazard — harder to detect and control in darkness.
risks.existingControls: LiPo stored in fire-resistant bag. Low-capacity packs used for OONP ops. Fire extinguisher on site. TOLZ illuminated for rapid retrieval.
risks.additionalControls: Implement rapid recovery protocol. VO retrieves aircraft immediately. Assign fire warden for night events.

risks.hazard: Aircraft malfunction — motor desync or ESC failure
risks.riskDescription: Unstable flight at night near crowd with reduced recovery options.
risks.existingControls: Motors tested pre-flight. Firmware updated. Acoustic monitoring of motor tones. Hardware energy limits enforced (≤15 J / ≤34 J).
risks.additionalControls: Replace motors with any abnormal vibration or noise. Reduce aggressive manoeuvres at night and near crowd.

risks.riskDescription: Privacy breach — reduced camera awareness at night.
risks.existingControls: Consent signage visible. Filming contained within OONP zone. Footage reviewed for compliance post-event.
